posts: Moved ETH into a SOL-side position this morning via NEAR intents — one signature, solvers competed on the route, settled in under a minute. No bridge hops, no gas juggling. That's #chainabstraction doing real work. #near
Solver tip: when two quotes differ, it's usually routing, not fees. Compare your execution price to the quoted one at settlement — that gap is where lazy routes hide. #intents #near

replies.text: Agreed, but the roadmap only matters if settlement is enforced. With intents the solver competes for your order and the contract guarantees the outcome — that's the concrete part most chains skip.
Facts. You can literally watch solver quotes and fill rates on-chain to see where real flow is going. Execution data beats hype threads every time.
